name: Ines Calloway
role: Founder and CEO of Saltmarsh Labs (fictional)
bio: Fictional eval persona. Second-time founder of Saltmarsh Labs, a made-up seed-stage startup building Driftwood, an API mocking tool for backend teams. Former backend engineer. Writes about the unglamorous parts of running a small company.
writing_rules: Use real numbers from the company, rounded if needed
Never end with a call to follow or subscribe
target_audience: First-time technical founders before Series A
opinions: Default alive math matters more than the next round
Founders should do sales until the pitch is boring
Your first engineer hire is a culture decision dressed as a technical one
writing_samples: We took 41 investor meetings to raise 1.6 million euros. Thirty-eight said no. Two of the no's taught me more than the yes.
I spent a month pretending I was fine. The tell was that I stopped reading customer emails, which I used to love.
